hints.title: Prefix Invariance
hints.text: To minimize the string lexicographically, prioritize placing smaller characters at the earliest possible index.

hints.title: First Discrepancy
hints.text: Look for the first character that can be replaced by a smaller character located later in the string.

hints.title: Reversal Candidate Comparison
hints.text: Examine candidate reversals anchored at the first imperfect index and select the minimal result.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Testing all valid substring reversals anchored at the earliest actionable index.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining arbitrary multi-step permutations explodes exponentially.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) memory for candidate string storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify early pivot point and compare bounded substring reversals.
